The '''Seventeenth Legislative Assembly of West Bengal''' constituted after the [[2021 West Bengal Legislative Assembly election]]s which were concluded on 29 April 2021 and the results announced on 2 May 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |title=West Bengal Election 2021: Voting dates, election results, full poll schedule, timings, all FAQs |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/economy-politics/story/west-bengal-assembly-election-2021-date-voting-time-poll-result-faqs-full-schedule-291693-2021-03-24 |access-date=2022-04-08 |website=Business Today |language=en}}</ref> The tenure of West Bengal Legislative Assembly ended on 7 May 2026.<ref>{{Cite web|title=West Bengal Governor dissolves legislative assembly effective from May 7|url=https://www.newsonair.gov.in/wb-governor-dissolves-assembly-political-parleys-on-to-form-governments-in-tamil-nadu-and-keralam/|website=Akashvani News|language=en-IN}}</ref>
